# Apno Dhun (अपणो धुन)

> राजस्थान री धरती रो संगीत, अपणा अंदाज में सुणो।
> The ultimate Rajasthani cultural music streaming platform by Apna Culturez.

## Overview
Apno Dhun (https://apnodhun.in) is a free, web-based music streaming sanctuary dedicated to preserving, celebrating, and modernizing Rajasthani heritage music, folk traditions, devotional bhajans, and underground Desi Hip Hop (DHH).

- **Website**: https://apnodhun.in
- **Creator / Curation**: Apna Culturez (https://instagram.com/apna.culturez)
- **Access**: 100% Free, no subscription or registration required.
- **Platforms**: Mobile Web (PWA), iOS Safari, Android Chrome, Desktop, iPad.

## Music Categories & Playlists

### 1. Lok (लोक री धुन - Authentic Rajasthani Folk)
- **Description**: Timeless Rajasthani folk classics celebrating the desert, bravery, love, and rural soul.
- **Top Songs**: Kesariya Balam, Padharo Mhare Des, Gorband Nakhralo, Nimbuda Nimbuda, Ghoomar, Chaudhary (Amit Trivedi ft. Mame Khan).
- **Artists**: Mame Khan, Ila Arun, Traditional Manganiyar & Langa folk musicians.
- **Direct Link**: https://apnodhun.in/?vibe=folk

### 2. Byaav (ब्याव रा गीत - Wedding & Banna Banni Bangers)
- **Description**: Authentic songs for royal Rajputana and Marwari wedding celebrations, Sangeet, and rituals.
- **Top Songs**: Banna Re Baga Me, Banni Tharo Banno Diwano, Pallo Latke, Moruda, Suvatiyo.
- **Direct Link**: https://apnodhun.in/?vibe=wedding

### 3. Bhakti (भगवान री भक्ति - Devotional & Marwari Bhajans)
- **Description**: Spiritual awakening through the poetry of Meera Bai, Baba Ramdev Ji, and Khatu Shyam.
- **Top Songs**: Khatu Shyam Bhajan, Baba Ramdev Ji Bhajan, Meera Bai Bhajan, Shreenathji Aarti, Jai Jai Rajasthan.
- **Direct Link**: https://apnodhun.in/?vibe=devotional

### 4. DHH (देसी हिप हॉप - Rajasthani Rap & Underground Hip Hop)
- **Description**: The cutting-edge new wave of Rajasthani youth culture blending traditional folk rhythms with hard-hitting 808s and Marwari bars.
- **Direct Link**: https://apnodhun.in/?vibe=dhh

### 5. Trend (नवो ट्रेंड - Contemporary & Viral Rajasthani Hits)
- **Description**: Chart-topping modern Rajasthani tracks trending globally.
- **Top Songs**: Loor, Mharo Rajasthan, Balam Thanedar, Tejaji Song.
- **Direct Link**: https://apnodhun.in/?vibe=trending

## Unique Interactive Features
- **Panchayat Live Community Chat**: A real-time community chat room where listeners interact using authentic Rajasthani monikers (Ranisa, Banna, Thakur Sahab, Hukum, Choudhary Sahab) and share songs directly.
- **Geet Maala (गीत माला)**: An interactive queue viewer with live track durations and instant category switching.
- **Royal Patrika Card Generator**: A 1-tap generator creating aesthetic Rajasthani wedding-invitation style cards for sharing music to Instagram Stories and WhatsApp Status.
- **Live Mehmaan (मेहमान Counter)**: Real-time listener counter celebrating every visitor as an honored guest.
- **Ghungroo (घुंघरू Percussion)**: Interactive audio chimes that trigger on keypress and tap.
- **PWA (Progressive Web App)**: Installable directly to phone home screens as a native music app.
